learnings: Models may conflate severe packaging bugs (e.g., serving the wrong architecture binary) with malicious supply chain attacks. Prompts should explicitly clarify that functional defects and packaging hygiene violations are not security injections unless they involve executing untrusted code or fetching from unauthorized hosts.
